exposure: parity (nulliparas vs. parous women with a previous vaginal birth)
cohort: 239,094 women in Queensland, Australia, who gave birth between July 1, 2012, and June 30, 2018
finding: The likelihood of primary cesarean section following IOL was significantly higher at 38 and 39 weeks, compared with expectant management up to 41(+6) weeks, for both nulliparas and paras with singleton cephalic pregnancies.
mod_finding: The likelihood of primary cesarean section was significantly higher at 38 and 39 weeks gestation among women who underwent induction of labor compared to expectant management up to 41+6 weeks.
